name: print-social-purple-neon-ai-agency-poster-set
title: Six purple neon AI-service posters with robot, lock and glass shapes
whatItIs: A vertical presentation of six poster-style posts with deep purple gradients and glowing violet accents. Each has a 3D or rendered hero (a lock, a robot head, atomic symbol and hand, glass cubes) plus a bold white headline and small CTA chips.
whatItMeans: Techy and premium; glow makes the AI subject feel powerful and high-value.
techniques: Render a single glossy object per post as the metaphor.
Keep the same purple gradient and glow across the set.
Use big white headlines with one bright accent word.
Add a slim CTA pill bar at the bottom of each.
bestFor: AI and software agency social sets

vocabulary.definition: A luminous edge or halo in a saturated colour.
A single rendered symbol representing the message.
A strip at the bottom holding action text.
Posts sharing the same background gradient.
